# telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group (Resource)

A group of email recipients can unsubscribe from, such as newsletters, without opting out of all mail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group" "newsletter" {
  name        = "Newsletter"
  description = "Monthly product news"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group's name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the group's mail is about.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String) View-only.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_unsubscribe_group.example <id>
```
